<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3+"
    pfs=""
>
[Charlatan's Gloves](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3064)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 286

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Tiny silver hooks decorate these fine silk gloves. They grant a +1 item bonus to Thievery and allow you to cast [_telekinetic hand_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1715) as an innate occult spell. 

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"
>
Charlatan's Gloves
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 286

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Charlatan's Gloves (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 286

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The gloves' bonus increases to +2. If you are also wearing a _charlatan's cape_, whenever you would move an object using [_telekinetic hand_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1715), you may instead have it disappear in a puff of smoke and reappear hovering in a space adjacent to yours. This is a teleportation effect. The item hovers until the end of your turn or until retrieved with an Interact action.
name: Charlatan's Gloves
